# Married In Moments

> Quick, legal, stress-free marriage services in Beaverton, Oregon, for couples across the Portland Metro: marriage license signings, styled Minute Chapel elopements, and Simply Eloped mini ceremonies at your own location. Ceremonies in English, Spanish, or bilingual (English + Spanish) at no extra charge. By appointment only. Owned by Shavon Shegog, an ordained officiant and dual-commissioned notary public (Oregon & Washington); sister brands: The Notaryous LLC and Oregon Fingerprinting.

Contact: (971) 715-2212 (text or call)
Email: info@marriedinmoments.com
Ceremony space: 20001 SW Tualatin Valley Hwy, Beaverton, OR 97003 (by appointment)
Availability: Just the Two of Us (license signing) can be booked any day of the week; The Minute Chapel, The Whole Moment, and Simply Eloped are Saturdays and Sundays. Phone and online booking answered seven days a week.
Service area: Beaverton, Portland, Hillsboro, Tigard, Lake Oswego, Gresham, and Washington, Multnomah, and Clackamas counties
Booking: https://marriedinmoments.com/book.html (ceremonies book at least 24 hours in advance)
Languages: English, Spanish, bilingual — a Spanish-speaking officiant is available for every package

## Packages

- **Just the Two of Us — Marriage License Signing:** $125 ($50 deposit). Legal signing of your marriage license, declaration and pronouncement of marriage, officiant present, priority mailing of the license to the county. About 5–10 minutes, Beaverton, OR. Designed for the couple only; Oregon law requires two witnesses — bring your own at no cost or we provide witnesses for $25 per person.
- **The Minute Chapel — Styled Elopement (most popular):** from $175 ($75 deposit). Ordained officiant, short pre-written ceremony, decorated elopement space in Beaverton with drapery backdrop (ivory or navy) and faux cake for photos, 15-minute ceremony plus a 30-minute mini photo session on your own device, priority UPS mailing of the license. 2 guests included; up to 4 guests +$25, up to 6 guests +$50. Optional Styled Backdrop (silk florals, twinkle lights, candlelight) $75.
- **The Minute Chapel + The Whole Moment (best value):** $374 ($150 deposit). The Minute Chapel elopement with The Whole Moment bundle included (Styled Backdrop, cake, set of 4 cookies, 6-rose bouquet, matching boutonniere, anniversary cookies).
- **Simply Eloped — Mini Ceremony at your location:** $250 flat ($100 deposit). Short 10–15 minute ceremony with introduction, ring vows, and pronouncement at your home or private location in the Portland Metro, up to 20 guests, priority mailing of the license. Balance billed 3 days before the appointment.

## Add-ons ("Little Extras")

- Custom vows, keepsake (commemorative) marriage certificate, photo add-on, first-dance recording: $25 each
- The Styled Backdrop: $75
- Cookies (hand-decorated): from $24 · Cake (6-inch, vanilla or chocolate, names on top): $50 · Roses (bouquet + boutonniere): from $15 · Champagne toast (bring your own bubbly; flutes provided): included
- Bundles: Sweet Start (cake + 4 cookies + anniversary cookies) $75; The Whole Moment (Styled Backdrop + cake + 4 cookies + 6-rose bouquet + boutonniere + anniversary cookies) $199
- Anniversary Cookies (two cookies mailed on your first anniversary): $12, included in both bundles
- Extras can be added when booking or up to 24 hours before the ceremony. Treats may contain common allergens.

## Policies

- A deposit secures your date and time and applies toward the total; the balance is billed at the start of the appointment (Simply Eloped: 3 days before).
- Deposits are refundable or transferable with at least 48 hours' notice; cancellations or reschedules within 48 hours forfeit the deposit.
- Bring your valid, unexpired Oregon marriage license (issued by any Oregon county) — the officiant cannot marry you without it. Oregon licenses have a 3-day waiting period after issuance unless waived by the county.
- Two witnesses are required by Oregon law at every marriage.
